title: Initial configuration check
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s$ be a natural number. The word $w$ passes the validity check for input length $|x|$ and space parameter $s$; scanning its initial segment of length $W(N)(2s+1)$ yields initial state $q_0$ with head position $0$ and the indicated Boolean flag true; the bit value of the following segment of length $w_P(|x|)$ is $1$; and either $N$ has no work tapes or the specified bit of $w$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The definitions of the validity check, scan operation, segment-width functions, and scanned tuple projections are absent, so the exact meaning of those conditions is not fully recoverable.
